channel.title: Pulse News — Real-Time Spatial News & Citizen Journalism
channel.description: C2PA-verified global news dispatches, 4K video journalism, and peer-reviewed eyewitness reporting.

item.title: Tokyo Unveils Autonomous Maglev Express Pod Linking Haneda to Shibuya in 6 Minutes
item.description: Reporting live from Shinagawa Terminal where JR East and Tokyo Metro engineers just completed the first public commuter run of the superconducting L0-Urban Maglev pod.

item.title: Emergency Coastal Surge Barriers Deployed in Rotterdam Ahead of North Sea Gale
item.description: Standing at the Maeslantkering sector where automated storm-surge arms have swung shut for the first time this season with wind gusts registering 118 km/h.

item.title: Lagos Solar Micro-Grid Powers 40,000 Homes and Tech Hubs Through 100% Battery Inverters
item.description: From the rooftop command center overlooking Yaba where engineers switched 42 community commercial transformers completely over to local lithium-iron phosphate arrays.
